scut_contact_window.semantics: per-wheel peak over 3 samples >1N; not simultaneous continuous loading

probe.metric_population: per-environment means after first 0.5 s, censored at FIRST termination; survival denominator includes all environments
probe.gain_compensated_clipping_semantics: actuator_local_order_v1: raw requested PD torque times episode and step gains minus final applied torque, all in the actuator joint order; includes pre/post gain hardware envelope clipping. 10ms snapshots, not substep peaks. Raw and unmapped gain shadow fields are retained.
probe.effort_sampling: 10ms control-step snapshots, not substep peak audit; computed-minus-applied >0.1Nm counts clipping

contact_physical_metrics_semantics.force_and_low_load: captured every.5ms; longest both norm force<=1N; low force is not airborne
contact_physical_metrics_semantics.gap_and_slip: sampled each10ms control; input USD hull support excludes cooking/offset/compliance; lowest-vertex slip approximation, not contact manifold
contact_physical_metrics_semantics.group_values: means of per-environment summaries; individual arrays retained in per_environment, not worst cases
contact_physical_metrics_semantics.integration: mean force per5ms impulse bins is a reward adaptation; bin pass is not continuous contact or legacy graduation

contact_capture_metadata.semantics: instantaneous sensor force at 5 ms endpoints; not accumulated impulses or continuous contact
contact_capture_metadata.force_between_solver_callbacks: piecewise constant step-average; not measured substep timing
contact_capture_metadata.reward_source: mean vector force = summed physical impulse /5ms; >1N per-wheel history maximum
contact_capture_metadata.peak_source: diagnostic only; not reward or graduation
contact_capture_metadata.adaptation: Aligned legacy kernel retained;2ms solver impulse apportioned by exact integer-time overlap into fixed5ms bins

probe.graduation_gate_contact_source: legacy control-endpoint shadow; corrected 5ms stats do not automatically promote speed
probe.height_credit_semantics: unweighted exp height * recent contact; weighted per control step = credit * 0.3 * 0.01
probe.physical_contact_evidence: reports/contact_probe_7450_20260930/FINDINGS.md in source root; 2kHz unload/gap/slip retained there, not overwritten by window stats
